load_image_classification_model_hub: load a pretrained image classification model from Hugging Face Hub and wrap it for ExecuTorch export
load_image_classification_model_local: load a local image classification model from disk path and prepare it for ExecuTorch lowering
register_image_classification_task: register an image classification model loading function under the task name image-classification using the register_task decorator
create_vision_encoder_exportable_module: create a VisionEncoderExportableModule instance wrapping an eager model for exporting and lowering to ExecuTorch
configure_image_classification_model_loa: load an image classification model with additional configuration options passed as kwargs to from_pretrained
